source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 8. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: The du'aas, the left foot in and the right foot out

learn.en: Before going to the toilet, put aside anything with Allah's name on it, like a ring or a pendant.
learn.title: Before you go in

learn.en: Step in with your left foot first and say the du'aa.
learn.title: Left foot in
learn.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبُثِ وَالخَبَائِثِ
learn.tr: Bismi-llāh. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-khubuthi wa l-khabāʾith

learn.en: Keep yourself covered from view. Don't talk or answer greetings. If you sneeze, say Alhamdulillah only in your heart.
learn.title: Inside

learn.en: Outdoors, go somewhere out of the way, don't face the qiblah, and never use a stone, the shade of a tree, a public place or a water supply.
learn.title: Outdoors

learn.en: Wash yourself with water using your left hand, then step out with your right foot and say: Ghufranak.
learn.title: Right foot out

learn.en: “Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.” (Qur'an 2:222)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

words.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الخُبُثِ وَالخَبَائِثِ
words.en: Entering: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek protection in You from the devils
words.tr: Bismi-llāh. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-khubuthi wa l-khabāʾith

quiz.en: I should enter the toilet with my ___ foot first.
I should wash up with my ___ hand.
True or false? I may take a ring with Allah's name into the toilet.
True or false? I must not talk while using the toilet.

think.q: Can you say the du'aa for entering the toilet without looking?
think.a: Bismi-llāh. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina l-khubuthi wa l-khabāʾith.

parents.summary: Toilet manners: no item with Allah's name, left foot in with the du'aa, silence, washing with the left hand, right foot out saying Ghufrānak.
parents.tip: Check together that he says both du'aas this week.
